text: EXPOSED: Elon Musk's AI revenue is about to CRUSH his entire space empire.

As SpaceX prepares to launch its AI-powered satellite constellation, Elon Musk claims that AI revenue will surpass its entire space business by next month, with estimates suggesting it could top $10 billion annually.

This raises questions about the future of space exploration, as AI-powered infrastructure becomes the backbone of the sector, potentially relegating human spaceflight to a secondary priority, and sparking debates about the role of AI in shaping the next generation of space missions.
